auth.label: Access Secret
auth.description: Zhihu Open Platform Access Secret sent with the Authorization: Bearer header. View it in the Zhihu Open Platform profile page: https://developer.zhihu.com/profile.

actions.name: favlist_contents
actions.description: List public content in one collection owned by the current Access Secret account.

limit.description: The number of items to return, up to 50.

FavTime.description: The favorite Unix timestamp in seconds.

IsEnd.description: Whether this is the last page.

NextOffset.description: The opaque offset for the next page.

actions.name: get_pdf_parse
actions.description: Get the status and temporary result URL for a Zhihu PDF parsing task.

inputSchema.description: The PDF parsing task to retrieve.

progress.description: The task progress from zero to one.

actions.name: get_ppt_generation
actions.description: Get the status and temporary PPTX download URL for a PPT generation task.

inputSchema.description: The PPT generation task to retrieve.

progress.description: The task progress from zero to one.

actions.name: global_search
actions.description: Search the global web index exposed by Zhihu Open Platform.

count.description: The number of global search results to return, up to 20.

filter.description: Advanced filter expression for host or publish_time constraints.

searchDB.description: The search index database to query.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for a Zhihu global search request.

ContentType.description: The content type, such as Answer or Article.

ContentText.description: The content excerpt. Highlighted fragments may include em tags.

Url.description: The source URL with Zhihu Open Platform attribution parameters.

AuthorBadge.description: The author certification badge image URL.

EditTime.description: The published or last edited Unix timestamp in seconds.

items.description: A selected comment returned with a content item.

CommentInfoList.description: Selected comments returned for this content item.

AuthorityLevel.description: The content authority level from 1 to 4.

RankingScore.description: The ranking score returned by Zhihu Search.

items.description: A Zhihu content search result item.

Data.description: The Zhihu global search response data.

actions.name: hot_list
actions.description: Get the current Zhihu hot list with titles, links, thumbnails, and summaries.

limit.description: The number of hot list items to return, up to 30.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for a Zhihu hot list request.

Total.description: The number of returned hot list items.

Url.description: The Zhihu URL for the hot list item.

ThumbnailUrl.description: The thumbnail image URL, or an empty string when no image is available.

Summary.description: The item summary, or an empty string when no summary is available.

Data.description: The Zhihu hot list response data.

actions.name: knowledge_base_items
actions.description: List content in a Zhida knowledge base using cursor pagination.

cursor.description: The opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: The number of items to return, up to 20.

inputSchema.description: The knowledge base and page to retrieve.

Total.description: The total number of content items.

NextCursor.description: The opaque cursor for the next page.

actions.name: knowledge_bases
actions.description: List Zhida knowledge bases created by or subscribed to by the current account.

scope.description: The relationship used to filter knowledge bases.

actions.name: knowledge_file_upload
actions.description: Download a file from an HTTP URL and upload it into a Zhida knowledge base.

fileUrl.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL whose file should be uploaded.

fileName.description: The file name, including a supported extension.

inputSchema.description: The source file and optional target knowledge base.

KnowledgeBaseID.description: The knowledge base that received the file.

FileSize.description: The uploaded file size in bytes.

Title.description: The parsed content title when available.

Abstract.description: The parsed content summary when available.

OriginUrl.description: The source file URL returned by Zhihu when available.

actions.name: knowledge_search
actions.description: Retrieve relevant document fragments from Zhida knowledge bases with RAG search.

inputSchema.description: The query and knowledge recall ranges. Provide at least one non-empty knowledgeBaseIds or recallScopes array.

knowledgeBaseIds.description: Knowledge base identifiers to search. Required when recallScopes is omitted.

recallScopes.description: Built-in recall scopes to search. Required when knowledgeBaseIds is omitted.

limit.description: The number of documents to return, up to 10.

allOf.description: The knowledge retrieval query and optional recall ranges.

anyOf.description: A request that searches explicit knowledge bases.
A request that searches built-in recall scopes.

allOf.description: At least one knowledge retrieval range is required.

actions.name: submit_pdf_parse
actions.description: Download a PDF from an HTTP URL, upload it to Zhihu, and submit an asynchronous parse task.

fileUrl.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of a PDF file up to 100 MB.

fileName.description: The PDF file name, ending in .pdf.

idempotencyKey.description: A key that makes repeated identical task submissions idempotent.

inputSchema.description: The source PDF and optional idempotency key.

actions.name: submit_ppt_generation
actions.description: Submit a Zhihu answer or article URL for asynchronous PPTX generation.

resourceUrl.description: A supported Zhihu answer or article URL.

numPages.description: The requested number of slides, from 6 to 21.

idempotencyKey.description: A key that makes repeated identical submissions idempotent.

inputSchema.description: The source content and requested slide count.

actions.name: user_collections
actions.description: List the current Access Secret owner's recently favorited public content.

limit.description: The number of recent favorites to return, up to 50.

FavTime.description: The favorite Unix timestamp in seconds.

actions.name: user_contents
actions.description: List the current Access Secret owner's public Zhihu creations.

limit.description: The number of items to return, up to 50.

sortField.description: The field used to sort results.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for user creations.

CreatedAt.description: The creation Unix timestamp in seconds.

IsEnd.description: Whether this is the last page.

NextOffset.description: The opaque offset for the next page.

actions.name: user_favlists
actions.description: List the current Access Secret owner's public Zhihu collections.

limit.description: The number of collections to return, up to 50.

actions.name: user_followees
actions.description: List the current Access Secret owner's public Zhihu followees.

limit.description: The number of followees to return, up to 50.

IsEnd.description: Whether this is the last page.

NextOffset.description: The opaque offset for the next page.

actions.name: zhida
actions.description: Create a non-streaming Zhihu Zhida chat completion.

items.description: A message in a Zhida chat completion request.

messages.description: Conversation messages to send to Zhida.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for a non-streaming Zhida chat completion request.

created.description: The creation Unix timestamp in seconds.

model.description: The model that produced the response.

reasoning_content.description: The model reasoning content when returned.

message.description: The assistant message returned by Zhida.

outputSchema.description: A non-streaming Zhida chat completion response.

actions.name: zhihu_search
actions.description: Search Zhihu content and return matching questions, answers, and articles.

count.description: The number of Zhihu search results to return, up to 10.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for a Zhihu site search request.

HasMore.description: Whether more results are available. Zhihu currently returns false.

ContentType.description: The content type, such as Answer or Article.

ContentText.description: The content excerpt. Highlighted fragments may include em tags.

Url.description: The source URL with Zhihu Open Platform attribution parameters.

AuthorBadge.description: The author certification badge image URL.

EditTime.description: The published or last edited Unix timestamp in seconds.

items.description: A selected comment returned with a content item.

CommentInfoList.description: Selected comments returned for this content item.

AuthorityLevel.description: The content authority level from 1 to 4.

RankingScore.description: The ranking score returned by Zhihu Search.

items.description: A Zhihu content search result item.

EmptyReason.description: The reason returned when the result set is empty.

Data.description: The Zhihu site search response data.
